name: Quebec Law 25 (Privacy Modernization)
description: An Act to modernize legislative provisions as regards the protection of personal information (formerly Bill 64) — Quebec's private-sector privacy law, phased in 2022-2024 with obligations exceeding PIPEDA.
authority: Commission d'acces a l'information du Quebec (CAI)
scope: Any enterprise that collects, holds, uses, or communicates personal information of Quebec residents in the course of carrying on an enterprise

families.name: Governance & Accountability
families.description: Organizational accountability for personal information protection

controls.name: Privacy Officer Designation
controls.description: Designate a person in charge of the protection of personal information (defaults to the highest-ranking person) and publish their title and contact details.

controls.name: Governance Policies & Practices
controls.description: Establish and publish governance policies and practices regarding personal information, framed to the sensitivity and volume processed.

controls.name: Privacy Impact Assessment
controls.description: Conduct a privacy impact assessment (PIA) for any information-system acquisition/development/overhaul project and before communicating PI outside Quebec.

controls.name: Privacy by Default
controls.description: Ensure technological products and services offered to the public have privacy-protective settings enabled by default at the highest level of confidentiality.

families.name: Consent & Transparency
families.description: Lawful basis, consent, and transparency obligations

controls.name: Consent & Purpose Limitation
controls.description: Obtain manifest, free, and enlightened consent for a specific purpose; consent requests must be presented separately and in clear language.

controls.name: Transparency at Collection
controls.description: Inform individuals at collection of the purposes, means, rights of access/rectification, and any third parties or use of technology that identifies/locates/profiles them.

controls.name: Automated Decision-Making Disclosure
controls.description: Where a decision is based exclusively on automated processing, inform the individual and allow them to submit observations and request review.

families.name: Individual Rights
families.description: Rights granted to individuals over their personal information

controls.name: Access & Rectification
controls.description: Provide access to personal information held and the ability to have inaccurate, incomplete, or equivocal information corrected.

controls.name: Data Portability
controls.description: On request, communicate computerized personal information to the individual in a structured, commonly used technological format.

controls.name: De-indexing & Cessation (Right to be Forgotten)
controls.description: Honour requests to cease dissemination and to de-index personal information where dissemination causes serious injury outweighing public interest.

families.name: Breach, Security & Transfers
families.description: Security safeguards, confidentiality incidents, retention, and cross-border transfers

controls.name: Security Safeguards
controls.description: Take security measures reasonable given the sensitivity, purpose, quantity, distribution, and medium of the personal information.

controls.name: Confidentiality Incident Response
controls.description: Maintain a register of confidentiality incidents; where there is risk of serious injury, notify the CAI and affected individuals promptly.

controls.name: Retention & Destruction
controls.description: Destroy or anonymize personal information once the purpose is fulfilled, subject to retention schedules and legal obligations.

controls.name: Cross-Border Transfer Assessment
controls.description: Before communicating personal information outside Quebec, assess whether it receives adequate protection, considering the legal framework of the destination.
